# Why Foundations

This is where the path starts: what machine learning *is*, how a model learns, and the Python I use to think on the page.

Python lives here on purpose. It is not a side menu. The Helsinki *Python Programming MOOC 2024* notes are part of the foundation of this wiki, and they stay.

# Already here

- [What is Machine Learning](/machine/machine-index.qmd) — the decision / error / optimisation loop, and the four learning paradigms (supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, reinforcement).
- [Python Programming](/python/python-index.qmd) — my notes from the University of Helsinki MOOC (`programming-24.mooc.fi`). Parts 1–3 are real notes; part 4 is started (parameter vs argument); parts 5–14 are still stubs I will fill.
- [Maths for machine learning](maths/maths-index.qmd) — short primers on the core symbols, linear algebra, calculus, probability and statistics, and optimization.

# Coming next

- A later “Python for ML” track (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, notebooks) *beside* the Helsinki notes, not instead of them.
